messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Saboda kawai Shugaban ƙasa yaje Kano ya gaisa da sarkin Kanon da ya sani Muhammadu Sanusi ll sun ɗan tattauna shine zai ce wai wasu ƙungiyoyi a Kano sun nemi ya tsige Sarkin Kano a irin sanarwar da ya saba ta tsakar dare to muna jira 😎😎😎

output.original_text: Saboda kawai Shugaban ƙasa yaje Kano ya gaisa da sarkin Kanon da ya sani Muhammadu Sanusi ll sun ɗan tattauna shine zai ce wai wasu ƙungiyoyi a Kano sun nemi ya tsige Sarkin Kano a irin sanarwar da ya saba ta tsakar dare to muna jira 😎😎😎
output.joy: Oh, saboda Shugaban ƙasa ya tafi Kano ya gaisa da sarkin Kanon, Muhammadu Sanusi ll! Sun tattauna, kuma ga labari mai kayatarwa cewa wasu ƙungiyoyi a Kano sun nemi ya tsige Sarkin Kano. Muna ta jira da sha'awa! 😄
output.sadness: Wannan labarin yana da nauyi. Shugaban ƙasa ya tafi Kano gaisawa da sarkin Muhammadu Sanusi ll, amma hakika, wasu ƙungiyoyi sun nemi ya tsige Sarkin Kano. Muna jiran kaddamar da wannan sabawa, kuma zuciyata tana jin tsoro. 😞
output.fear: Wannan labarin yana da ɗan firgici. Shugaban ƙasa ya kai ziyara Kano, gaisawa da sarkin Muhammadu Sanusi ll, amma yanzu wasu ƙungiyoyi na neman ya tsige Sarkin. Ina fargaba game da abin da zai faru! 😨
output.anger: Na ji zafin wannan labarin! Shugaban ƙasa ya je Kano, yana gasawa da Muhammadu Sanusi ll, amma yanzu wasu ƙungiyoyi suna ƙoƙarin tsige Sarkin Kano? Wannan ba daidai bane! 😡
output.surprise: Wow, ban yi tsammani ba! Shugaban ƙasa ya ziyarci Kano don gaisawa da sarkin Muhammadu Sanusi ll, sannan ina jin cewa wasu ƙungiyoyi suna so ya tsige Sarkin? Muna jiran karin bayani daga gare su! 😲
